notes:
PASS on the fake backend; evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. gate.digest is the digest line printed by the last gate run. Served device mhs://localhost/robosuite-hammer-place, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R1: MHS-004 section 2.1 lists simulation stepping as R1, no physical robot arm is modelled, there is no hardware backend, and SAFE-045 (R2/R3 hardware) does not apply. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposes the MujocoDriver family helper and lists five robosuite environment classes but no model. HammerPlaceEnv subclasses robosuite's SingleArmEnv and builds its MuJoCo scene, objects, samplers and observables in its constructor and _load_model (robosuite_task_zoo/environments/manipulation/hammer_place.py:19 and :138-303); a MujocoDriver serves one MJCF file through model_path/mj_step and cannot carry the environment's reset()/step(action) interface or the absent model. This package is therefore a direct Driver over the card's first entry symbol, robosuite_task_zoo.environments.manipulation.hammer_place:HammerPlaceEnv, with the package fake .fake:FakeHammerPlaceEnv; it still binds the card's cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.step.v1. All five card entry symbols were confirmed in the clone: HammerPlaceEnv (hammer_place.py:19), KitchenEnv (kitchen.py:18), MultitaskKitchenDomain (multitask_kitchen.py:17), ToolUseEnvBase (tool_use.py:17) and ToolUseEnv (tool_use.py:545). Only HammerPlaceEnv is served (one device per package); the other four are not.

cap.world.reset.v1 calls reset() and records the seed in the receipt. The robosuite reset takes no seed and the clone exposes no seed method; the placement sampler draws from numpy's process-wide generator (hammer_place.py:443-456), so the MHS seed does not steer the state and fidelity.determinism.kind is none. cap.world.step.v1 calls step(action) once per tick with action.values and forwards the upstream (obs, reward, done, info) 4-tuple; step replaces done with _check_success (hammer_place.py:495-499). The e-stop closes the environment, the runtime latches, and the operator reset calls reset() again.

The fake is a physics-free F0 stand-in: a fixed placeholder start state, a placeholder first-order end-effector motion, reward always 0.0, done always false, and no task success. Its observation is a placeholder dictionary with the keys the clone names (robot0_eef_pos, robot0_eef_quat and robot0_gripper_qpos at hammer_place.py:530-533, plus robot0_joint_pos, robot0_joint_vel, contact, force norm and hammer/CabinetObject poses); all numbers in fake.py are test data marked # placeholder, not facts. NOT COVERED: the agentview and robot0_eye_in_hand camera images. The real observation also carries those images and the object/contact observables (use_camera_obs=True and 256x256 camera defaults at hammer_place.py:28 and :43-45), whose keys and lengths depend on the robot and camera configuration.

No Limit is declared: the action vector's shape and range come from the robosuite controller selected by constructor controller_configs; the documented benchmark action space is OSC_POSITION (3) plus Gripper (1) (environments.md:39) and the clone special-cases action_dim 4 (hammer_place.py:489-492), but that is a constructor default, not a device bound, so the driver accepts any non-empty numeric vector. timestep_ms is 0 because control_freq 20 is a constructor option (hammer_place.py:39) and the physics step comes from the robosuite model, which is not in the clone; ticks count control steps. truncated is false because the clone's step replaces done with _check_success and only adds history_ft/recent_ft to info.

Warnings kept: G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x2 for reset and close, which come from robosuite's SingleArmEnv, a base outside the clone (hammer_place.py:19), and both names occur throughout the clone; G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because no sourced Limit is declared on an actuating capability, so SAFE-014 has nothing to probe (the suite awarded CL2 and the check report has no other failing test). G4 had no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings.

robosuite, mujoco-py, numpy, numba and scipy were not installed and the upstream environment was never installed, imported or run; the clone was never modified. No hardware was attached and no hardware run was made. The package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is {"kind": "model", "model_id": "deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017", "run_id": "wC-063"} and reviewed_by stays null. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
